//: Pinned files of EmbeddingGemma 2 q4 (EMBEDDING_MODEL in ../model.ts), kept as JSON so the app's build tooling (apps/mobile/scripts/fetch-model.mjs, plugins/withBundledModel.js) reads the same pins without TypeScript. `device` files are bundled inside the app and checked against `sha256`; `source` says where the build fetches a file: `hf` from `hfRepo` at `revision` on Hugging Face (or the MODEL_MIRROR_URL mirror), `mirror` only from the mirror (files we build ourselves, such as prototypes.bin). Changing a pin is a model change (model.ts header).
